# Pritesh Rathod - API Services

> Direct links and specifications for portfolio REST endpoints.

- [OpenAPI Specification](https://priteshrathod.vercel.app/openapi.json): Full machine-readable API contract
- [Protected Resource Metadata](https://priteshrathod.vercel.app/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 discovery
- [Home Endpoint](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/api/home): GET /api/home
- [Projects Endpoint](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/api/projects): GET /api/projects
- [Skills Endpoint](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/api/skills): GET /api/skills
- [Contact Endpoint](https://portfolio-i5x9.onrender.com/api/contact): POST /api/contact
